name: Access One
summary: Melbourne ISP strong in corporate sector; acquired by OzEmail (subsidiary by Dec 1997; aone.net.au redirected to OzEmail by early 1999); OzEmail was itself acquired by UUNET/WorldCom in 1999.

names.name: Access One
source: Earliest Wayback capture of aone.net.au 11 Dec 1997 ('Access One Home Page'): https://web.archive.org/web/19971211100402id_/http://www.aone.net.au/

events.details: Founded in Melbourne; email domains @aone.net.au. Existence confirmed by Dec 1997 (earliest Wayback capture).
Acquired by OzEmail (subsidiary by Dec 1997); by Feb 1999 aone.net.au was a meta-refresh redirect to ozemail.a1.com.au, confirming OzEmail ownership.
